simple.meaning: a hump or peak of hills

definitions.short: a hump or peak of hills
definitions.full: H1386. gabnon [ גַּבְנֹן ] noun [masculine] peak, rounded summit ; plural ׃גַּבְנֻנִּים Psa 68:16 הַרגֿ הַרבָּֿשָׁ֑ן ׳הַראֱֿלֹהִים הַרבָּֿשָֽׁן׃ ; ג ׳הָרִים 68:17 (appositive, Thes Dr § 188 and others; others adjective many-peaked ). compare Wetzst Batan. Giebelgeb. 1884 . גבע ( convex, projecting, high ; compare Aramaic Pa`el גַּבַּע swell, swell up , גְּבִיעַ hump-backed , גִּבְעֲתָא hill ; see also I. גִּבְעָה below)
